verses.text: Moreover, the Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the east gate of the LORD'S house which faced eastward. And behold, [there were] twenty-five men at the entrance of the gate, and among them I saw Jaazaniah son of Azzur and Pelatiah son of Benaiah, leaders of the people.
verses.textZh: 靈將我舉起，帶到耶和華殿向東的東門。誰知，在門口有二十五個人，我見其中有民間的首領押朔的兒子雅撒尼亞和比拿雅的兒子毗拉提。

verses.text: He said to me, 'Son of man, these are the men who devise iniquity and give evil advice in this city,
verses.textZh: 耶和華對我說：人子啊，這就是圖謀罪孽的人，在這城中給人設惡謀。

verses.text: who say, 'Is not [the time] near to build houses? This [city] is the pot and we are the flesh.'
verses.textZh: 他們說：蓋房屋的時候尚未臨近；這城是鍋，我們是肉。

verses.text: 'Therefore, prophesy against them, son of man, prophesy!'
verses.textZh: 人子啊，因此你當說預言，說預言攻擊他們。

verses.text: Then the Spirit of the LORD fell upon me, and He said to me, 'Say, 'Thus says the LORD, 'So you think, house of Israel, for I know your thoughts.
verses.textZh: 耶和華的靈降在我身上，對我說：你當說，耶和華如此說：以色列家啊，你們口中所說的，心裡所想的，我都知道。

verses.text: 'You have multiplied your slain in this city, filling its streets with them.'
verses.textZh: 你們在這城中殺人增多，使被殺的人充滿街道。

verses.text: 'Therefore, thus says the Lord GOD, 'Your slain whom you have laid in the midst of the city are the flesh and this [city] is the pot; but I will bring you out of it.
verses.textZh: 所以主耶和華如此說：你們殺在城中的人就是肉，這城就是鍋；你們卻要從其中被帶出去。

verses.text: 'You have feared a sword; so I will bring a sword upon you,' the Lord GOD declares.
verses.textZh: 你們怕刀劍，我必使刀劍臨到你們。這是主耶和華說的。

verses.text: 'And I will bring you out of the midst of the city and deliver you into the hands of strangers and execute judgments against you.
verses.textZh: 我必從這城中帶出你們去，交在外邦人的手中，且要在你們中間施行審判。

verses.text: 'You will fall by the sword. I will judge you to the border of Israel; so you shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.textZh: 你們必倒在刀下；我必在以色列的境界審判你們，你們就知道我是耶和華。

verses.text: 'This [city] will not be a pot for you, nor will you be flesh in the midst of it, [but] I will judge you to the border of Israel.
verses.textZh: 這城必不作你們的鍋，你們也不作其中的肉。我必在以色列的境界審判你們，

verses.text: 'Thus you will know that I am the LORD; for you have not walked in My statutes nor have you executed My ordinances, but have acted according to the ordinances of the nations around you.'''
verses.textZh: 你們就知道我是耶和華；因為你們沒有遵行我的律例，也沒有順從我的典章，卻隨從你們四圍列國的惡規。

verses.text: Now it came about as I prophesied, that Pelatiah son of Benaiah died. Then I fell on my face and cried out with a loud voice and said, 'Alas, Lord GOD! Will You bring the remnant of Israel to a complete end?'
verses.textZh: 我正說預言的時候，比拿雅的兒子毗拉提死了。於是我俯伏在地，大聲呼叫說：哎！主耶和華啊，你要將以色列剩下的人滅絕淨盡麼？

verses.text: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.textZh: 耶和華的話臨到我說：

verses.text: 'Son of man, your brothers, your relatives, your fellow exiles and the whole house of Israel, all of them, [are those] to whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, 'Go far from the LORD; this land has been given us as a possession.'
verses.textZh: 人子啊，耶路撒冷的居民對你的弟兄、你的本族、你的親屬、以色列全家，就是對大眾說：你們遠離耶和華罷！這地是賜給我們為業的。

verses.text: 'Therefore say, 'Thus says the Lord GOD, 'Though I had removed them far away among the nations and though I had scattered them among the countries, yet I was a sanctuary for them a little while in the countries where they had gone.''
verses.textZh: 所以你當說：耶和華如此說：我雖將以色列全家遠遠遷移到列國中，將他們分散在列邦內，我還要在他們所到的列邦，暫作他們的聖所。

verses.text: 'Therefore say, 'Thus says the Lord GOD, 'I will gather you from the peoples and assemble you out of the countries among which you have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.''
verses.textZh: 你當說：主耶和華如此說：我必從萬民中招聚你們，從分散的列國內聚集你們，又要將以色列地賜給你們。

verses.text: 'When they come there, they will remove all its detestable things and all its abominations from it.
verses.textZh: 他們必到那裡，也必從其中除掉一切可憎可厭的物。

verses.text: 'And I will give them one heart, and put a new spirit within them. And I will take the heart of stone out of their flesh and give them a heart of flesh,
verses.textZh: 我要使他們有合一的心，也要將新靈放在他們裡面，又從他們肉體中除掉石心，賜給他們肉心，

verses.text: that they may walk in My statutes and keep My ordinances and do them. Then they will be My people, and I shall be their God.
verses.textZh: 使他們順從我的律例，謹守遵行我的典章。他們要作我的子民，我要作他們的神。

verses.text: 'But as for those whose hearts go after their detestable things and abominations, I will bring their conduct down on their heads,' declares the Lord GOD.
verses.textZh: 至於那些心中隨從可憎可厭之物的，我必照他們所行的報應在他們頭上。這是主耶和華說的。

verses.text: Then the cherubim lifted up their wings with the wheels beside them, and the glory of the God of Israel hovered over them.
verses.textZh: 於是，基路伯展開翅膀，輪子都在他們旁邊；在他們以上有以色列神的榮耀。

verses.text: The glory of the LORD went up from the midst of the city and stood over the mountain which is east of the city.
verses.textZh: 耶和華的榮耀從城中上升，停在城東的那座山上。

verses.text: And the Spirit lifted me up and brought me in a vision by the Spirit of God to the exiles in Chaldea. So the vision that I had seen left me.
verses.textZh: 靈將我舉起，在異象中藉著神的靈將我帶進迦勒底地，到被擄的人那裡；我所見的異象就離我上升去了。

verses.text: Then I told the exiles all the things that the LORD had shown me.
verses.textZh: 我便將耶和華所指示我的一切事都說給被擄的人聽。
